actions.script: findParams = Object.assign({}, ec.web.parameters) delete findParams.pageIndex delete findParams.pageSize delete findParams.pageNoLimit

label.text: Parameters in the URL (the form submits to this screen), number cards, two charts and a result table with exports and a totals row over the whole filtered set, over moqui.server.ArtifactHitBin. ${usingFallback ? 'ArtifactHitBin has no rows, so the data is an inline sample and the type list comes from it.' : 'The data is the live ArtifactHitBin table.'}

Fallbacks for style-guide section 8: number cards are q-card with text-overline and text-h5 until number-card exists; the muted caption class is text-grey-7/text-grey-5 by mode until m-muted exists; chart colors are read from the --q-* brand variables when the chart draws.

render-mode.text:
Hits
${cardHits}
in ${binCount} bins
Artifacts
${cardArtifacts}
distinct names
Average time
${cardAvg} ms
max ${cardMax} ms
Slow hits
${cardSlow}
over 2.6 standard deviations

<m-chart height="240px" :config='((cv, tc, gc) => ({type: "bar", data: {labels: ${typeLabelsJson}, datasets: [{label: "Hits", data: ${typeHitsJson}, backgroundColor: cv("primary"), borderColor: cv("primary"), borderRadius: 3}]}, options: {maintainAspectRatio: false, animation: false, plugins: {legend: {display: false}}, scales: {x: {ticks: {color: tc}, grid: {display: false}}, y: {beginAtZero: true, ticks: {color: tc, precision: 0}, grid: {color: gc}}}}}))( (name) => (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).getPropertyValue("--q-" + name).trim(), (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).color, (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).color.replace(/^rgba?\((\d+,\s*\d+,\s*\d+)[^)]*\)$/, "rgba($1, 0.12)"))'></m-chart>

box-header.title: Hits and average time by day

render-mode.text: <m-chart height="240px" :config='((cv, tc, gc) => ({type: "line", data: {labels: ${dayLabelsJson}, datasets: [ {label: "Hits", data: ${dayHitsJson}, borderColor: cv("primary"), backgroundColor: cv("primary"), tension: 0.3, yAxisID: "y"}, {label: "Average ms", data: ${dayAvgJson}, borderColor: cv("secondary"), backgroundColor: cv("secondary"), tension: 0.3, yAxisID: "y1"}]}, options: {maintainAspectRatio: false, animation: false, plugins: {legend: {position: "bottom", labels: {color: tc, boxWidth: 12}}}, scales: {x: {ticks: {color: tc}, grid: {display: false}}, y: {beginAtZero: true, position: "left", ticks: {color: tc, precision: 0}, grid: {color: gc}}, y1: {beginAtZero: true, position: "right", ticks: {color: tc}, grid: {drawOnChartArea: false}}}}}))( (name) => (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).getPropertyValue("--q-" + name).trim(), (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).color, (c) => c.chart.canvas.ownerDocument.defaultView.getComputedStyle(c.chart.canvas).color.replace(/^rgba?\((\d+,\s*\d+,\s*\d+)[^)]*\)$/, "rgba($1, 0.12)"))'></m-chart>
